mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_stack_tower_score (user_id, max_floor, perfect_count, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{maxFloor}, #{perfectCount}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.max_floor AS score, s.perfect_count AS secondaryScore FROM game_stack_tower_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.max_floor DESC, s.perfect_count DESC, s.achieved_at ASC, u.nickname ASC
